nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: Every Saturday morning, I make pancakes for my family.
Today, before breakfast, I'm checking the kitchen.
We have some flour and a lot of sugar, but there isn't much milk, just a little.
There are a few eggs in the fridge, but not many: only two, and I need three.
We don't have any butter, and there aren't any bananas.
So here's my shopping list: milk, six eggs, some butter, four bananas and some honey.
First, I put two cups of flour, a little sugar and a little salt in a big bowl.
Then I add three eggs and some milk, and I mix everything.
After that, I heat a little butter in a pan and cook the pancakes, one by one.
How many pancakes do I make?
Finally, I put some banana and a little honey on top.
My children love pancakes with a lot of honey.
My husband doesn't eat much sugar, so he has his pancakes with a little cheese.
